scorecard: Management’s credibility is mixed; the only testable FY27 targets (margin and revenue growth) are still pending and show divergent results, while the majority of promises cannot be validated with the disclosed numbers.
business: Asian Paints manufactures and sells decorative paints and related products, aiming to beautify, transform and preserve spaces and objects. The company emphasizes brand building, innovation, premiumisation and an expanded service offering.
bull: EBITDA margin hit 21% in Q1 FY27, above the 18‑20% guidance
Revenue grew 18% YoY in Q1 FY27, meeting the lower end of the 18‑20% FY27 target
FY26 EBITDA margin rose to 19% from 18% in FY25, showing margin improvement
bear: EBITDA margin fell to 16% in Q2 FY27, below the 18‑20% guidance
